description.fr-FR: Trois écrits de direction : la lettre sur la fréquente communion (1718), les lettres sur la confession et le fréquent usage des sacrements de Pénitence et d’Eucharistie (1738) et la lettre sur la direction (1737).
description.en-US: Three pieces of direction: the letter on frequent communion (1718), the letters on confession and the frequent use of the sacraments of Penance and the Eucharist (1738), and the letter on spiritual direction (1737).
description.pt-BR: Três escritos de direção: a carta sobre a comunhão frequente (1718), as cartas sobre a confissão e o uso frequente dos sacramentos da Penitência e da Eucaristia (1738) e a carta sobre a direção espiritual (1737).

fr-FR.editor: J.-E.-A. Gosselin (éd. Saint-Sulpice), Paris: Leroux et Jouby / Gaume

sources.edition: Œuvres complètes de Fénelon, Paris, Leroux et Jouby, 1851 (éd. Gosselin, Saint-Sulpice), tome 5, p. 712–770; archive.org OCR (ABBYY).
sources.description: Machine-cleaned OCR: running heads, page numbers and hyphenation removed, paragraphs rejoined, obvious character errors corrected by a vote against the corpus vocabulary; period spelling kept. Residual OCR errors remain (see PROBLEMS.md).
sources.tierEvidence: Fénelon died in 1715; the 1851 edition is public domain.
